label_cfu_billion / guaranteed_cfu_billion: when both are public, both are stored.
Prices removed entirely. Korean health-functional-food regulation discourages in-app pricing.
data_source = URL where the entry was verified. verified_date = YYYY-MM-DD.
ingredients = {} means the product is registered for search but quantitative amounts were not publicly available; the analysis engine skips it.
